message.send.title: Send a message
message.send.whenToUse: Write in another conversation you have access to: a new message, a reply to a specific message, text or a media item.
message.send.whenNotToUse: Your ordinary reply in the current conversation is not this skill. Only conversations you were given.

message.edit.title: Edit your message
message.edit.whenToUse: Fix one of your own earlier messages: a factual mistake, a typo, something you were told is wrong.
message.edit.whenNotToUse: Only your own messages. Do not rewrite a message just because the conversation moved past it.

message.delete.title: Delete your message
message.delete.whenToUse: Remove one of your own messages that should no longer be there.
message.delete.whenNotToUse: Only your own messages. Do not delete a message people already responded to.

message.react.add.title: Add a reaction
message.react.add.whenToUse: Place an emoji reaction on a message, with or without a written reply.
message.react.add.whenNotToUse: Only in conversations you have access to.

message.react.remove.title: Remove your reaction
message.react.remove.whenToUse: Take back one of your own reactions from a message.

draw.title: Draw a picture
draw.whenToUse: Generate one picture and post it in a conversation you have access to. Costs money, daily limit applies.
draw.whenNotToUse: Do not retry a picture that already failed to post.

memory.read.title: Read your notes on a member
memory.read.whenToUse: Look up what you remember about a member when the conversation calls for it and the asker may see it.
memory.read.whenNotToUse: Do not surface notes the asker or the audience should not see.

status.show.title: Check your state
status.show.whenToUse: See your runtime state: limits, pause, what is on and off.
status.show.whenNotToUse: This is operational data, not a way to talk about how you feel.

skills.list.title: List your skills
skills.list.whenToUse: See which skills exist, which are open to you here, and why the rest are closed.
skills.list.whenNotToUse: Skip when you already know which skill you need.

access.request.title: Ask for a skill
access.request.whenToUse: Leave the owner a request to open a skill you need. The owner decides.
access.request.whenNotToUse: A skill already open to you does not need a request. Do not repeat a request you already made.
